question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing cheerleader, Fred is playing left back, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Finally, Alice and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right midfielder
(C) benchwarmer
(D) center midfielder
(E) cheerleader
(F) left back
(G) right winger
solution:
Positions in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left midfielder, right midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, cheerleader, left back, right winger
1. Dave ↔ Eve: left midfielder, right midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader, center midfielder, left back, right winger
2. Eve ↔ Dave: left midfielder, right midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, cheerleader, left back, right winger
3. Gertrude ↔ Claire: left midfielder, right midfielder, right winger, center midfielder, cheerleader, left back, benchwarmer
4. Eve ↔ Gertrude: left midfielder, right midfielder, right winger, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left back, cheerleader
5. Bob ↔ Fred: left midfielder, left back, right winger, center midfielder, benchwarmer, right midfielder, cheerleader
6. Fred ↔ Eve: left midfielder, left back, right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader
7. Alice ↔ Dave: center midfielder, left back, right winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader
Eve is playing right midfielder, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
